Recorded claim:
Bug 1898136 showed a sent message raised PopularityIndex on a CardDAV contact, then a server fetch replaced the card and lost that local value. The accepted first patch copies stored properties that the server does not know about onto the server-derived card. It excludes vCard, ETag, href, LastModifiedDate, and BANISHED_PROPERTIES so remote and managed data stay authoritative. Current CardDAV code keeps this copy. When a sync rebuilds a card, distinguish local-only metadata from server-managed data and test both updated and newly added contacts.
